hourly.summary: Arsenal fans are sweating over Kai Havertz's potential hamstring injury while simultaneously melting down over the Gyökeres transfer saga — one poster colorfully noting 'the dildo of consequences rarely arrives lubed.' Throw in Declan Rice's non-red card controversy and a sprinkle of transfer optimism (Tzolis, Mosquera), and you've got a fanbase clutching its collective pearls while staring at the treatment room door.

daily.summary: The day began with relief over Arteta's long-term extension, soured into anger at VAR decisions and anxiety after a chastening 3-0 loss at Brighton, then swung back to elation following Declan Rice's massive new deal and a Women's UWCL win. A volatile 24 hours defined by contract security bookending a mid-day crisis of confidence.

weekly.summary: Arsenal fan sentiment traced a dramatic boom-and-bust arc across the week: cautious optimism early on built into bullish, title-chasing euphoria by mid-week, only to implode catastrophically after a 3-0 loss at Brighton on the 19th. The final two days saw sentiment plummet from peak confidence (8/10) to meltdown and despair (3/10), with Arteta's 'lack of respect' critique, exposed defensive frailties, and extinguished title hopes defining a thoroughly miserable finish.
